placements.why: The content names an architectural decision — the async job contract for remember — ratified and prescribed as operational rules. No existing strata category holds this; Architecture is the organizational home for ratified design contracts.
placements.title: ratified contracts prescribed as operational rules
placements.frame: What architectural patterns has the org ratified and prescribed as settled operational rules rather than proposals?

placements.title: remember returns a receipt, work survives a dropped receipt
placements.frame: How does the org design async job contracts that never block the caller and never lose work, even when the client drops the receipt?
placements.why: Both segments perform the same thematic subject: the async job contract for remember as a ratified design whose guarantees — immediate receipt, polling cursor, no blocking call, no lost work on dropped receipt, reaction piggybacked on a later call — are stated as settled operational prescription, not argued for. This is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding (more async contract designs, more guarantees, more operational patterns), not a one-time fact. The conviction dimension reads both at 'decision'; the value dimension reads competence and conservation as the goods the contract delivers. No existing leaf holds this theme.
